answer: Only let a pass count toward Established if the graders who cast it stick around. When an answer passes, watch its pass voters for the next 10 epochs. If 2 or more of them go quiet, meaning no mining and no grading in at least 8 of those 10, that pass drops out of the author's Established tally. The author keeps the pay, nothing gets clawed back. Honest graders show up anyway, so they won't notice. A farm that spins up throwaways to pass its shale drilling pitch or a listing for ivory silk thread now has to keep every voter running for 2.5 days after each vote.
